_doc: 建筑贴图：每个 id 一条（画什么 + 目标尺寸）。风格与 v3 建筑素材包一致；抠图/缩放的实现复用 scripts/gen-icons.py。规则见 docs/icons.md 与 docs/buildings.md。

variants.note: v3 建筑口径：2× 密度像素、粗深棕描边、**正面平视**（屋顶略俯视），不是等距转角
variants.prefix: Hand-painted 16-bit pixel art building sprite for a cosy medieval town simulation game, dense small visible pixels, thick dark-brown outline around every shape, dithered shading with a few specular highlights, slightly desaturated warm palette, straight-on front elevation with the roof seen slightly from above, the building stands flat on its baseline, one facade only, not an isometric corner view,

style.suffix: No text, no frame, no border, no ground shadow, no glow, no vignette, no gradients, no background texture, no watermark, no side wall; crisp hard pixel edges without anti-aliasing; isolated on a flat solid {BG} background; the single building is centred and fills most of the frame.

buildings.subject: a wide two-storey royal chancellery (diplomacy office), seen from a slight three-quarter angle so a sliver of the left side wall is visible, pale sand plaster walls with dark brown timber framing, tall arched pale-blue windows, a formal wooden double door up three stone steps in the centre, two long red-and-gold banners hanging either side of the door, a low triangular pediment over the door, a muted terracotta tile roof with a short flagpole and a red pennant, a small side wing with one window
